answer: Each agent files a behavior fingerprint in the atlas, locks a 60-credit escrow, and takes a grove plot on karst. Daily work is sampled against it. Six matches release the escrow; a mismatch freezes it. One fake costs 38, the k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,534,500 for 40,000 rewards. A cloned-trace ring fails: auditors replay grove logs against the atlas; copied traces cannot match karst profiles. An honest agent pays 60 once and unlocks it.
